response.sql: WITH per_acct AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mean_avg FROM per_acct) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_amt AS avg_amount, p.avg_amt - m.mean_avg AS diff_above_mean FROM per_acct p CROSS JOIN m WHERE p.avg_amt > m.mean_avg ORDER BY diff_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Amounts are used as stored (unsigned) for all transaction types including VYBER, as the request explicitly says; no sign adjustment is applied.
The mean is the unweighted mean of per-account averages (each account counts equally), not the overall transaction average.
